name: Tares Parable Of
overview: The Parable of the Tares, as taught in Matthew 13:24-29, illustrates the kingdom of heaven through the imagery of a man sowing good seed in his field, only for an enemy to secretly plant tares among the wheat. When both wheat and tares grow together, the servants inquire about removing the tares, but the householder instructs them to wait to avoid uprooting the wheat. This teaches the patient and discerning nature of God's kingdom, where good and evil coexist until the final harvest, emphasizing God's sovereign judgment and care in preserving the faithful until that time.
